verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several APIs (Alerts, Case, Case import, filing), so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy, and the probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404. Having APIs at all is adjacent to this story and earns no credit toward versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
